sources.snippet: A fine-tuned Gemma 3 1B instruction model specialized for English-to-Luganda translation and Luganda conversational AI. The model accepts input in both English and Luganda but outputs responses exclusively in Luganda.

sources.snippet: Background [Fab AI blog post — link here]. EduGanda-Gemma-3-1B (Crane AI Labs, 2026) is a 1B parameter model for foundational literacy education in Uganda, trained in Luganda via CPT → SFT → GRPO → model merge. The blog acknowledges a position bias in the benchmark results (B: 93%, D: 41%) caused by an imbalanced training dataset.
